subject: [PATCH v4 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

2026-09-30.patch_summary: This patch updates the NUMA balancing code in the Linux kernel to use VMA flag helpers instead of directly accessing vm_flags. This change is made to improve code readability and maintainability by encapsulating the logic for checking specific flags within the VMA structure. The existing flag predicates remain unchanged, and no functional changes are intended. The patch applies to three files: kernel/sched/fair.c, mm/internal.h, and mm/migrate.c.
